title: Make label in Gtk.MessageDialog selectable
commit_message:
Make label in Gtk.MessageDialog selectable
    
To allow users to copy parts of the text, for example the GitHub
verification code.
diff:
diff --git a/gtk/apport-gtk b/gtk/apport-gtk
index 5e9c3b1..ac4fd39 100755
--- a/gtk/apport-gtk
+++ b/gtk/apport-gtk
@@ -423,6 +423,10 @@ class GTKUserInterface(apport.ui.UserInterface):
         else:
             # work around gnome #620579
             self.md.set_property("text", text)
+        # Make the label in the message area selectable to allow users
+        # to copy the text (to allow them to copy the GitHub
+        # verification code, for example)
+        self.md.get_message_area().get_children()[0].set_selectable(True)
         self.md.set_title(title)
         result = self.md.run()
         self.md.hide()
